subject: Request: temporary headroom for overnight peak POC - Velocity Analytics
messages:
From: Lucas Grant <lucas@velocity.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@velocity.ai
Date: Sun, 08 Aug 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC evening peak - request for temporary headroom

Ben / Priyom,

Thanks again for the call this morning. We're planning an overnight throughput spike for the Velocity Retail POC to validate end-to-end latency under sustained peak (18:00–02:00 PT next Thursday). The test will exercise real user traffic patterns and ramp to ~3x our normal test QPS to validate batching and cache behavior.

Quick ask: can Redwood provision a short, timeboxed headroom/top‑up for the POC so we don't hit quota throttles mid-test? Target uplift: ~120k token-equivalent units for a contiguous 48h window starting 2027-08-12 18:00 PT. We'll only hit the high QPS for ~6 of those hours; the rest is soak.

Attached: velocity_test_plan.pdf (high-level schedule + traffic profile).

If you need a signed MOU or an approval path from procurement, looping them in. Appreciate a quick confirmation today so we can finalize the test script.

—Lucas
Lucas Grant
Head of Platform Engineering, Velocity Analytics
lucas@velocity.ai | +1 415-555-0190

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Lucas Grant <lucas@velocity.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 08 Aug 2027 18:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC evening peak - request for temporary headroom

Lucas — thanks for the plan and the timeline. We can support a timeboxed uplift; want to get internal signoff on the exact amount and guardrails.

Priyom — can you review the traffic profile and propose an exact uplift (tokens or ephemeral quota) we can commit to for the window (2027-08-12 18:00 PT to 2027-08-14 18:00 PT)? Also cc'ing Marissa for commercial visibility—if there are any pricing/discount considerations we should flag.

Next steps (proposed):
- Priyom: recommend uplift amount + any model restrictions (e.g., non-prod endpoints, fallback model)
- Marissa: approve promo extension / voucher or confirm if finance signoff required

I'll hold the request until we have the green light.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lucas Grant <lucas@velocity.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC evening peak - request for temporary headroom

Ben / Lucas — reviewed the test plan. Suggested approach: a 48h uplift window is fine, but to be conservative we recommend provisioning 120k token-equivalents for the period you called out. That maps to the traffic profile and gives a ~20% buffer.

Constraints / guardrails:
- Restrict to non-production endpoints (playground and dedicated POC endpoints)
- Apply automatic fallback to a quantized model variant if sustained 95th-percentile latency exceeds our agreed SLOs for >15 minutes
- Telemetry hooks enabled so we can stop the uplift early if abnormal error rates appear

Attachments: mop-template.docx — use this if Velocity wants a short mutual action plan to sign.

Marissa — the uplift is within the promotional headroom band we usually authorize. I can put the temporary voucher in place once we have your ok. If finance needs a PR, flag it and I'll route.

—Priyom

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lucas Grant <lucas@velocity.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC evening peak - request for temporary headroom

Approved from Sales leadership side with the following notes:
- Approve 120k token-equivalent uplift for 48 hours (2027-08-12 18:00 PT to 2027-08-14 18:00 PT).
- Must be applied to non-prod POC-only endpoints; no production routing.
- Set an automatic throttle/fallback plan to the small-quantized model variant if latency or error rate breaches are detected.
- Provide Velocity with a promo voucher PDF and attach a short MOP for signatures if procurement prefers.

Priyom: please create the voucher and drop it in the deal record. Ben: coordinate the final schedule and confirm the start time with Lucas.

(Attaching internal approval stamp)
Attachment: approved_by_sales_lead.png

—Marissa Cole
Head of Growth, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Lucas Grant <lucas@velocity.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, procurement@velocity.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC evening peak - request for temporary headroom

Lucas — good news: we have approval. Details below and attaching the voucher.

Confirmed uplift:
- Amount: 120,000 token-equivalents (promotional voucher)
- Window: 2027-08-12 18:00 PT through 2027-08-14 18:00 PT (48 hours)
- Endpoints: Redwood non-production POC endpoints only (as discussed)
- Guardrails: automatic fallback to quantized model if sustained p95 latency > target for >15 minutes; telemetry will be monitored and Redwood will revoke uplift early if error telemetry spikes.

Billing note: this will appear as a promotional voucher applied against the trial allowance for deal VA-1173. If usage exceeds the voucher, we will reach out to procurement for any overage charges.

Attached: promo-voucher-VA-1173.pdf
